mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forecast_detail(version_id,source_row_no,priority_seq,factory_code,material_id,material_name,business_line,form_type,project,platform,mold,status,plan_month,forecast_qty) SELECT #{versionId},COALESCE(original.source_row_no,l.priority_seq),COALESCE(original.priority_seq,l.priority_seq), l.factory_code,l.material_id,l.material_name,l.business_line,l.form_type,l.project,l.platform,l.mold,l.status, STR_TO_DATE(k.plan_month,'%Y-%m-%d'),CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.months_json,CONCAT('$.',JSON_QUOTE(k.plan_month)))) AS DECIMAL(18,6)) FROM forecast_draft_line l JOIN JSON_TABLE(JSON_KEYS(l.months_json),'$[*]' COLUMNS(plan_month VARCHAR(10) PATH '$')) k LEFT JOIN forecast_detail original ON original.version_id=(SELECT base_version_id FROM forecast_draft WHERE id=#{draftId}) AND original.factory_code=l.factory_code AND original.material_id=l.material_id AND original.plan_month=STR_TO_DATE(k.plan_month,'%Y-%m-%d') WHERE l.draft_id=#{draftId} AND l.is_deleted=0
mapper.sql: FROM (SELECT factory_code,material_id,plan_month FROM forecast_detail WHERE version_id=#{oldId} UNION SELECT factory_code,material_id,plan_month FROM forecast_detail WHERE version_id=#{newId}) k LEFT JOIN forecast_detail o ON o.version_id=#{oldId} AND o.factory_code=k.factory_code AND o.material_id=k.material_id AND o.plan_month=k.plan_month LEFT JOIN forecast_detail n ON n.version_id=#{newId} AND n.factory_code=k.factory_code AND n.material_id=k.material_id AND n.plan_month=k.plan_month

WHERE 1=1 AND k.factory_code=#{factoryCode} AND (k.factory_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR k.material_id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR o.material_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR n.material_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) AND (o.id IS NULL OR n.id IS NULL OR o.forecast_qty<>n.forecast_qty OR o.priority_seq<>n.priority_seq OR NOT (o.material_name<=>n.material_name AND o.form_type<=>n.form_type AND o.project<=>n.project AND o.platform<=>n.platform AND o.mold<=>n.mold AND o.status<=>n.status))
mapper.select: SELECT k.factory_code AS factoryCode,k.material_id AS materialId,DATE_FORMAT(k.plan_month,'%Y-%m') AS planMonth, COALESCE(n.material_name,o.material_name) AS materialName,o.forecast_qty AS oldQty,n.forecast_qty AS newQty, CASE WHEN o.id IS NULL THEN 'ADDED' WHEN n.id IS NULL THEN 'REMOVED' WHEN o.forecast_qty<>n.forecast_qty THEN 'QUANTITY' WHEN o.priority_seq<>n.priority_seq THEN 'PRIORITY' WHEN NOT (o.material_name<=>n.material_name AND o.form_type<=>n.form_type AND o.project<=>n.project AND o.platform<=>n.platform AND o.mold<=>n.mold AND o.status<=>n.status) THEN 'ATTRIBUTE' ELSE 'UNCHANGED' END AS changeType, CASE WHEN o.id IS NOT NULL AND n.id IS NOT NULL THEN n.forecast_qty-o.forecast_qty ELSE NULL END AS delta, o.priority_seq AS oldPriority,n.priority_seq AS newPriority ORDER BY k.factory_code,k.material_id,k.plan_month LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*)
mapper.sql: FROM (SELECT factory_code,material_id,plan_month FROM forecast_detail WHERE version_id=#{baseVersionId} UNION SELECT l.factory_code,l.material_id,STR_TO_DATE(k.plan_month,'%Y-%m-%d') AS plan_month FROM forecast_draft_line l JOIN JSON_TABLE(JSON_KEYS(l.months_json),'$[*]' COLUMNS(plan_month VARCHAR(10) PATH '$')) k WHERE l.draft_id=#{draftId} AND l.is_deleted=0) keys_ LEFT JOIN forecast_detail o ON o.version_id=#{baseVersionId} AND o.factory_code=keys_.factory_code AND o.material_id=keys_.material_id AND o.plan_month=keys_.plan_month LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.id,l.factory_code,l.material_id,l.material_name,l.form_type,l.project,l.platform,l.mold,l.status,l.priority_seq, STR_TO_DATE(k.plan_month,'%Y-%m-%d') AS plan_month, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.months_json,CONCAT('$.',JSON_QUOTE(k.plan_month)))) AS DECIMAL(18,6)) AS forecast_qty FROM forecast_draft_line l JOIN JSON_TABLE(JSON_KEYS(l.months_json),'$[*]' COLUMNS(plan_month VARCHAR(10) PATH '$')) k WHERE l.draft_id=#{draftId} AND l.is_deleted=0) n ON n.factory_code=keys_.factory_code AND n.material_id=keys_.material_id AND n.plan_month=keys_.plan_month

WHERE 1=1 AND keys_.factory_code=#{factoryCode} AND (keys_.factory_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR keys_.material_id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR o.material_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR n.material_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) AND (o.id IS NULL OR n.id IS NULL OR o.forecast_qty<>n.forecast_qty OR NOT (o.material_name<=>n.material_name AND o.form_type<=>n.form_type AND o.project<=>n.project AND o.platform<=>n.platform AND o.mold<=>n.mold AND o.status<=>n.status))
